record.paper_title: Some Open Problems Related to Creative Telescoping
record.context_brief: Existence and order of telescopers over fields
record.original_question: For creative telescoping over liouvillean fields in the differential setting, and over ΠΣ-fields in the shift setting, derive a criterion that decides when a telescoper exists. In every case where telescopers do exist, also derive bounds on their order.

evidence.quote: Problem 4.1 For the creative telescoping problem over liouvillean fields (in the differential case) or for ΠΣ-fields (in the shift case), derive a criterion for the existence of a telescoper. For the cases where telescopers exist, derive bounds on their order.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background. Creative telescoping seeks, for a given function f(x,y), a nonzero linear operator T(x,∂_x) (called a telescoper) acting only in the variable x and a "certificate" g such that
   T(x,∂_x)(f) = Δ_y(g),
where Δ_y is the derivation ∂_y in the differential setting or the forward shift difference S_y − 1 in the shift setting.

Differential setting. Let k be a field of characteristic 0. A liouvillean extension of k(x) is a tower
   k(x) = F_0 ⊂ F_1 ⊂ ⋯ ⊂ F_n = F
of differential fields such that each F_{i+1} = F_i(t_{i+1}) is obtained by adjoining an element t_{i+1} that is either algebraic over F_i, or an integral (∂(t_{i+1}) ∈ F_i), or an exponential of an integral (∂(t_{i+1})/t_{i+1} ∈ F_i). Suppose F carries a second commuting derivation ∂_x with constants k(y)-related structure so that f ∈ F makes sense as a function of (x,y).

Shift setting. A ΠΣ-field over a constant field k is a difference field built as a tower
   k = F_0 ⊂ F_1 ⊂ ⋯ ⊂ F_n = F
where each F_{i+1} = F_i(t_{i+1}) is a Π-extension (S(t_{i+1})/t_{i+1} ∈ F_i*) or a Σ-extension (S(t_{i+1}) − t_{i+1} ∈ F_i), with the constants unchanged at each step; these fields model nested sums and products under the shift S = S_y. Assume an additional commuting shift S_x is given.

Problem. In each of the two settings above:
(a) Provide an effective criterion that, given f in such a field F, decides whether there exists a nonzero telescoper T(x,∂_x) (respectively T(x,S_x)) for f, i.e., a nonzero linear operator in x and the corresponding operator (∂_x or S_x) together with an element g ∈ F satisfying T(f) = Δ_y(g).
(b) Whenever such a telescoper exists, give an explicit bound, in terms of the structural data of f and of the tower defining F, on the minimal order of T.
artifact.category_tag: creative telescoping in differential and difference fields
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of existence criteria and order bounds for telescopers over liouvillean fields (differential) and ΠΣ-fields (shift) is generally open. Partial results exist for specific subclasses (e.g., hyperexponential and hypergeometric inputs, certain elementary or D-finite cases, and reduction-based algorithms providing existence/order bounds in restricted settings), but no general criterion or order bound covering the full liouvillean/ΠΣ classes is known in the literature surveyed.

status_evidence.title: Some Open Problems related to Creative Telescoping
status_evidence.snippet: Problem 4.1: derive a criterion for the existence of a telescoper over liouvillean fields and ΠΣ-fields, and bounds on the order.
status_evidence.claim: Listed as an open problem; only partial results for narrower classes are known.

status_evidence.title: Telescopers for Rational and Algebraic Functions
status_evidence.snippet: Existence and order bounds for telescopers in restricted (rational/algebraic) cases.
status_evidence.claim: Partial solutions exist for subclasses of liouvillean/ΠΣ inputs.
